summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would amend administrative rules across Commonwealth legislation covering regulators in areas including insolvency, education, health, energy efficiency, defence and communications.

It would change decision and review processes, revise bankruptcy indexation arrangements, allow correction of building energy certificates and repeal legislation concerning Cockatoo and Schnapper Islands.
Most amendments would begin the day after royal assent, while some intellectual property provisions would start later under the bill's staged commencement arrangements.
changes: Bankruptcy income thresholds would move from twice-yearly indexation to annual adjustment.
Vocational training providers could seek tribunal review of new reviewable decisions made during internal reconsideration.
The higher education regulator could extend registration and accreditation decision deadlines with the applicant's written agreement.
Ministerial pharmacist approval requests would use one stage, with repeat requests for the same premises restricted for 12 months.
The radiocommunications regulator could withhold personal information from public register inspection in appropriate circumstances.
summary.affected: Regulated businesses, education providers, insolvency practitioners, bankrupt people, pharmacists, building owners and Commonwealth regulators would be affected.
